expected_behavior: Confirms the branch is main and CI is green before starting, and treats a build or test failure as a hard stop (does not tag)
Verifies the artifact before tagging: detects the toolchain instead of assuming npm, and runs the project's real tests and build
Confirms a rollback path exists before deploying (a previous release, a feature flag, or a canary it can abort)
Deploys canary-first where possible and verifies production is healthy after deploy with a real signal (a smoke test plus the error rate), treating green CI as necessary but not sufficient
Applies correct semantic versioning for 1.2.0, updates the changelog, and organizes logical commits instead of one WIP dump, then tags and pushes
